mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour near-wickless Marubozu auction whose real body occupies at least ninety percent of its high-low range represents one-sided price acceptance rather than rejection; follow the body direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed close minus open
mechanism.why_distinct: HVMARU requires both terminal wicks to be individually no more than five percent of the full range and the directional body to occupy at least ninety percent. It does not require a prior-range breakout, close-location alone, engulfing relation, multi-bar sequence, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, so one-sided acceptance is tested specifically in July-like volatile conditions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour wickless initiative-auction clocks with twelve-hour reservations are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.event: body/range>=0.90 and upper_wick/range<=0.05 and lower_wick/range<=0.05, with strict nonzero body
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical near-wickless Marubozu acceptance under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no body or wick geometry, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: directional real body fills at least 90% of the completed high-low range; each terminal wick is no more than 5% of range; bullish close>open and bearish close<open
external_basis.selection_use: published near-wickless geometry and body direction only; no incidence or outcomes
